snippet.title: Blast Head
snippet.description:
Hundreds of bullets, ridiculous weapons and pure unstoppable chaos.
Blast Head is a bullet-heaven roguelite where a slingshot can turn into an apocalypse machine and a flip-flop = ,,klapek”  becomes the deadliest weapon in the universe.

If you’re into fast, intense sessions, endless combos and games that keep whispering “one more run”, then this is your new obsession.
